name: superpowers-plus
description: Workflow orchestration wrapping superpowers — design and planning, delivery and testing assessment, graph-linked validation cycles, reachability, session handoff, editorial work, and the full bug-hunt, health-review, and performance-audit workflows. CC BY 4.0-adapted expression is limited to `skills/software-delivery-assessment/references/agentic-delivery.md`, `skills/software-delivery-assessment/references/capability-model.md`, and `skills/software-delivery-assessment/references/testing-model.md`; see `skills/software-delivery-assessment/SOURCE-MAP.md`, `skills/software-delivery-assessment/LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0`, and `skills/software-delivery-assessment/README.md` for provenance and license details.

interface.longDescription: Twenty workflow skills that wrap superpowers into front-to-back workflows: brainstorming-enhanced; editorial-pass; build-robust-features; design-review-cycle; wire-walk; writing-plans-enhanced; plan-review-cycle; handoff; four bug-hunter methodologies; bug-hunt-cycle; project-health-review; health-review-cycle; performance-audit; performance-audit-cycle; writing-skills-enhanced; software-delivery-assessment (evidence-grounded delivery and testing assessment without assuming continuity); and software-delivery-assessment-cycle (frozen-root validation through graph-linked addenda and optional authorized planning). All sibling skills, no cross-plugin runtime dependencies.
